Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

Source: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md

Our pledge

We are committed to making participation in this project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

Our standards

Examples of behavior that contribute to a positive environment include respectful disagreement, welcoming questions, and focusing feedback on the work rather than the person. Unacceptable behavior includes harassment, personal attacks, discrimination, and publishing private information without permission.

Enforcement

Report concerns privately to the repository owner through the contact details on their GitHub profile. Reports will be reviewed and handled in confidence.
